description: This is a Flask/FastAPI backend source file defining API endpoints for user registration, login, user info retrieval, and CRUD operations on 'notes' resources with JWT authentication and CORS middleware configuration.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Representing user data model, used for authentication and user info.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Representing note data model linked to user.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple health check endpoint that returns a 'Healthy' message.

methods.name: register(user_in: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with username, email, and password, stores hashed password.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: get_me(current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: create_note(note: schemas.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new note associated with the current user.

methods.name: list_notes(db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves all notes belonging to the current user, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its ID, only if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note_in: schemas.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates an existing note's data if owned by the current user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a note owned by the current user by its ID.

methods.name: openapi_auth_help()
methods.description: Provides instructions on how to authenticate with JWT to access protected endpoints.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.signature: (note: schemas.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db)):$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, note_in: schemas.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db),$/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, note_in: schemas.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(auth.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
